assignments.title: SQL Query Set
assignments.brief: Answer the supplied multi-part query set covering selection, aggregation, multi-table joins and outer joins. For each query, state its relational algebra equivalent and identify any aggregate-after-join hazard present in the question.

rubric.description: Every query returns the required columns with correct filtering and grouping.
NULL handling and empty-result cases handled deliberately.
Queries formatted and commented so intent is evident.

assignments.title: Normalisation Exercise
assignments.brief: For each supplied relation, list the candidate keys and the functional dependencies, identify every violation of 3NF and of BCNF, and produce a lossless decomposition. State explicitly whether each decomposition preserves dependencies, and justify the answer.

rubric.description: Candidate keys, dependencies, violations and decompositions all correct.
Losslessness and dependency preservation proved rather than asserted.
Worked instances supplied for each claimed violation.

assignments.title: Transaction Schedule Analysis
assignments.brief: For each supplied schedule, state which isolation level it is valid under, identify every anomaly it exhibits, and give a serial schedule that is equivalent to it. Explain whether two-phase locking would have prevented the anomalies and whether the schedule is recoverable.

rubric.description: Anomalies identified and an equivalent serial schedule produced correctly.
Isolation level and recoverability argued correctly.
Conclusion states plainly which claim is and is not justified.
